text_block_list.text:
A veritable mountain of plushies, all for
me.
Thank you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I feel not only happy, but also
strangely at
peace. I can't help but
smile.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm getting this soft, warm feeling—and
not just
from the plushies themselves.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because... this gift came
from the
heart.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
